attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determines if corporation must file Washington B&O tax return. Washington B&O tax nexus: Physical presence (office, employees, property) or Economic nexus ($100,000 or more in Washington receipts OR 200+ transactions). Note: No minimum filing threshold - any taxable activity requires filing. References: RCW 82.04.067 (Nexus), WAC 458-20-193 (Interstate Sales), WAC 458-20-19401 (Economic Nexus).

condition_details.condition_description: apportionment.has_physical_presence is true AND apportionment.state_code is "WA"
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true cvb eq apportionment.state_code WA streq and

condition_details.condition_description: apportionment.has_economic_nexus is true AND apportionment.state_code is "WA"
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true cvb eq apportionment.state_code WA streq and

action_details.action_comment: Physical nexus - B&O tax filing required
action_details.action_description: Physical nexus established - B&O tax filing required (calculated by table 51080)
action_details.action_postfix: "Washington B&O tax filing required due to physical presence. Physical presence includes: office/business in WA, employees in WA, tangible property in WA, inventory in WA, or regular solicitation in WA. References: RCW 82.04.067 (Nexus), WAC 458-20-193 (Interstate Sales), WAC 458-20-19401 (Economic Nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus - B&O tax filing required
action_details.action_description: Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required
action_details.action_postfix: "Washington B&O tax filing required due to economic nexus. Economic nexus threshold (either): $100,000 or more in Washington receipts (gross revenue), OR 200 or more separate transactions in Washington. Washington adopted economic nexus following South Dakota v. Wayfair (2018). References: RCW 82.04.067 (Economic Nexus), WAC 458-20-19401 (Economic Nexus Rules), South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_description: No Washington nexus - no B&O tax filing requirement
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.wa_bo_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No Washington nexus - no B&O tax filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates Washington-sourced gross receipts for B&O tax using apportionment. Washington B&O tax is based on gross receipts from activities in Washington including: sales of tangible property delivered in WA, services performed in WA, royalties from WA sources, rental income from property located in WA. Uses single-factor receipts apportionment (market-based sourcing). References: RCW 82.04.460 (Apportionment), WAC 458-20-19402 (Single-Factor Receipts), WAC 458-20-14601 (Service Activities).

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate WA gross receipts
condition_details.condition_description: apportionment.has_economic_nexus is true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence is true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true cvb eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true cvb eq or

condition_details.condition_comment: Has calculated apportionment percentage to Washington

action_details.action_comment: Calculate WA gross receipts using apportionment
action_details.action_description: Calculate WA-sourced gross receipts using apportionment percentage
action_details.action_postfix: revenue.total_revenue apportionment.apportionment_percentage mul /result.wa_gross_receipts xdef "Washington gross receipts calculation for B&O tax: Washington uses market-based sourcing (destination) for activities: Sales of tangible property (destination of goods), Services (location where customer receives benefit), Intangibles/royalties (location of customer), Rental income (location of property). The B&O tax applies to gross receipts (revenue), not net income. References: RCW 82.04.460 (Apportionment), WAC 458-20-19402 (Single-Factor Receipts Apportionment), WAC 458-20-14601 (Service and Other Activities)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_description: No apportionment calculated - treating all receipts as Washington-sourced
action_details.action_postfix: revenue.total_revenue /result.wa_gross_receipts xdef "No apportionment percentage calculated - treating all receipts as Washington-sourced. This is conservative approach when apportionment data is unavailable." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no WA gross receipts
action_details.action_description: No Washington nexus - no gross receipts attributed to Washington
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.wa_gross_receipts xdef "No Washington nexus - no gross receipts attributed to Washington." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determines the business classification for B&O tax rate purposes. Washington B&O tax rates vary by business activity: Service/Other Activities (0.484%), Retailing (0.471%), Wholesaling (0.484%), Manufacturing (0.484%), Professional Services (0.484%), Financial Business (1.5%). Note: In practice, businesses may have multiple classifications and must report each separately. References: RCW 82.04.240 (Manufacturing), RCW 82.04.250 (Retailing), RCW 82.04.290 (Service/Financial).

action_details.action_postfix: result.wa_retailing_rate /result.wa_bo_tax_rate xdef "Washington B&O tax - Retailing classification: 0.471%. Retailing includes sales of tangible personal property to consumers for consumption or use (not for resale). References: RCW 82.04.250 (Retailing), RCW 82.04.470 (Retailing B&O Tax Rate)" job.audit_trail swap addto

result.wa_wholesaling_rate /result.wa_bo_tax_rate xdef "Washington B&O tax - Wholesaling classification: 0.484%. Wholesaling includes sales of tangible personal property to persons for purpose of resale. References: RCW 82.04.060 (Wholesaling), RCW 82.04.270 (Wholesaling B&O Tax)" job.audit_trail swap addto

result.wa_manufacturing_rate /result.wa_bo_tax_rate xdef "Washington B&O tax - Manufacturing classification: 0.484%. Manufacturing includes production of articles for sale from raw materials, including processing, fabricating, assembling, extracting. Note: Certain manufacturers may qualify for preferential rates or exemptions. References: RCW 82.04.240 (Manufacturing), RCW 82.04.440 (Manufacturing B&O Tax)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_description: Set financial business B&O tax rate
action_details.action_postfix: result.wa_financial_rate /result.wa_bo_tax_rate xdef "Washington B&O tax - Financial Business classification: 1.5% (highest rate). Financial business includes banks, savings and loan associations, credit unions, finance companies, insurance companies, and similar institutions. Reference: RCW 82.04.290 (Financial Business)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_description: Set professional services B&O tax rate
action_details.action_postfix: result.wa_professional_rate /result.wa_bo_tax_rate xdef "Washington B&O tax - Professional Services classification: 0.484%. Professional services include legal, accounting, engineering, consulting, and other professional activities. Reference: RCW 82.04.290 (Service and Other Activities)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Service and Other Activities B&O rate: 0.484%
action_details.action_description: Set service and other activities B&O tax rate
action_details.action_postfix: result.wa_service_rate /result.wa_bo_tax_rate xdef "Washington B&O tax - Service and Other Activities classification: 0.484%. This is the catch-all classification for business activities not specifically classified elsewhere. Reference: RCW 82.04.290 (Service and Other Activities)" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates the Washington small business B&O tax credit. Small Business B&O Credit: Available for businesses with gross revenue under $250,000, credit amount varies based on total revenue and phases out as revenue increases, reduces B&O tax liability (can reduce to zero but not create refund). Maximum credit approximately $100-120 per month ($1,200-1,440 annually). References: RCW 82.04.4451 (Small Business B&O Credit), WAC 458-20-104 (Small Business Tax Relief).

condition_details.condition_comment: Total revenue below $250K small business threshold
Has Washington gross receipts subject to B&O tax

action_details.action_comment: Qualifies for small business B&O credit
action_details.action_description: Calculate small business credit (phases out as revenue approaches $250K)
action_details.action_postfix: true cvb /result.wa_qualifies_for_small_business_credit xdef 1.0 revenue.total_revenue result.wa_small_business_credit_threshold div sub /credit_percentage xdef 1440.0 /max_annual_credit xdef max_annual_credit credit_percentage mul /result.wa_small_business_credit xdef "Washington Small Business B&O Tax Credit: Businesses with gross revenue under $250,000 qualify for a small business credit that reduces B&O tax liability. Credit phases out as revenue increases. Credit is calculated on monthly basis and varies based on: total gross revenue (all sources), type of business activity, location (may vary for different jurisdictions). Credit cannot exceed B&O tax liability (no refunds for excess credit). References: RCW 82.04.4451 (Small Business B&O Credit), WAC 458-20-104 (Small Business Tax Relief)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_description: No small business credit - gross revenue exceeds $250,000 threshold
action_details.action_postfix: false cvb /result.wa_qualifies_for_small_business_credit xdef 0.0 /result.wa_small_business_credit xdef "No small business credit - gross revenue exceeds $250,000 threshold." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No credit - no WA gross receipts
action_details.action_description: No small business credit - no Washington gross receipts to apply credit against
action_details.action_postfix: false cvb /result.wa_qualifies_for_small_business_credit xdef 0.0 /result.wa_small_business_credit xdef "No small business credit - no Washington gross receipts to apply credit against." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates final Washington Business and Occupation (B&O) tax liability. IMPORTANT: Washington has NO corporate income tax. The B&O tax is a gross receipts tax, NOT an income tax. Process: 1) Calculate WA-sourced gross receipts (table 51020), 2) Determine business classification rate (table 51040), 3) Calculate B&O tax = gross receipts × B&O rate, 4) Apply small business credit (table 51060), 5) Apply other credits (high tech, aerospace), 6) Calculate refund or amount owed. Key Differences from Income Tax: Based on GROSS RECEIPTS (revenue) not net income, no deductions for expenses/COGS/payroll, much lower rates (under 1.5%) but applies to gross revenue, must be paid even if business operates at a loss. References: RCW 82.04 (Business and Occupation Tax), WAC 458-20-104 (Small Business Tax Relief), Form ETA (Combined Excise Tax Return).

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe B&O tax
condition_details.condition_description: apportionment.has_economic_nexus is true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence is true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true cvb eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true cvb eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate B&O tax with all credits
action_details.action_description: Calculate Washington B&O tax on gross receipts and apply all credits
action_details.action_postfix: result.wa_gross_receipts result.wa_bo_tax_rate mul /result.wa_bo_tax xdef 0.0 result.wa_bo_tax result.wa_small_business_credit sub max /result.wa_bo_tax xdef 0.0 result.wa_bo_tax result.wa_high_tech_credit sub max /result.wa_bo_tax xdef 0.0 result.wa_bo_tax result.wa_aerospace_credit sub max /result.wa_bo_tax xdef 0.0 result.wa_bo_tax apportionment.state_credits sub max /result.wa_bo_tax xdef result.wa_bo_tax /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "Washington Business and Occupation (B&O) Tax Calculation: IMPORTANT - Washington has NO corporate income tax. The B&O tax is a gross receipts tax, NOT an income tax. 1) Washington gross receipts: [WA-sourced revenue], 2) Business classification: [service/retailing/wholesaling/manufacturing/financial], 3) B&O tax rate: [0.471%-1.5% depending on classification], 4) B&O tax before credits: [Gross receipts × Rate], 5) Small business credit: [Credit if revenue < $250K], 6) Other credits: [High tech, aerospace, etc.], 7) B&O tax liability: [Final tax]. Key Differences from Income Tax: Based on GROSS RECEIPTS (revenue) not net income, no deductions for expenses/COGS/payroll, much lower rates (under 1.5%) but applies to gross revenue, must be paid even if business operates at a loss. References: RCW 82.04 (Business and Occupation Tax), WAC 458-20-104 (Small Business Tax Relief), Form ETA (Combined Excise Tax Return), Washington Department of Revenue Publication (B&O Tax Classification)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.wa_bo_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No Washington nexus - no B&O tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto
